parameters.query:
INSERT INTO governance.mission_runs (
  run_id, mission_id, branch, status, phase, nn, total, last_event_ts,
  last_error_code, last_error_excerpt_256, report_ref, udn_state, integrity_hash, updated_at
) VALUES (
  '{{$json.run_id_sql}}',
  '{{$json.mission_id_sql}}',
  '{{$json.branch_sql}}',
  '{{$json.status_sql}}',
  '{{$json.phase_sql}}',
  {{$json.nn}},
  {{$json.total}},
  CASE WHEN '{{$json.last_event_ts_sql}}' = '' THEN now() ELSE '{{$json.last_event_ts_sql}}'::timestamptz END,
  NULLIF('{{$json.last_error_code_sql}}',''),
  NULLIF('{{$json.last_error_excerpt_256_sql}}',''),
  NULLIF('{{$json.report_ref_sql}}',''),
  '{{$json.udn_state_canonical_sql}}',
  '{{$json.integrity_hash_sql}}',
  now()
)
ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO UPDATE SET
  mission_id = EXCLUDED.mission_id,
  branch = EXCLUDED.branch,
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  phase = EXCLUDED.phase,
  nn = EXCLUDED.nn,
  total = EXCLUDED.total,
  last_event_ts = EXCLUDED.last_event_ts,
  last_error_code = EXCLUDED.last_error_code,
  last_error_excerpt_256 = EXCLUDED.last_error_excerpt_256,
  report_ref = EXCLUDED.report_ref,
  udn_state = EXCLUDED.udn_state,
  integrity_hash = EXCLUDED.integrity_hash,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING run_id, mission_id, branch, status, phase, nn, total,
  to_char(last_event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS last_event_ts,
  last_error_code, last_error_excerpt_256, report_ref, udn_state, integrity_hash;

SELECT COALESCE(
  jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'run_id', run_id,
      'mission_id', mission_id,
      'branch', branch,
      'status', status,
      'phase', phase,
      'nn', nn,
      'total', total,
      'last_event_ts', to_char(last_event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
      'last_error_code', last_error_code,
      'last_error_excerpt_256', last_error_excerpt_256,
      'report_ref', report_ref,
      'udn_state', udn_state,
      'integrity_hash', integrity_hash,
      'updated_at', to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
    )
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
  ),
  '[]'::jsonb
) AS mission_runs
FROM governance.mission_runs;

UPDATE governance.hub_snapshots
SET is_active = false
WHERE snapshot_type = 'mission_runs_v1'
  AND is_active = true;

INSERT INTO governance.hub_snapshots (
  snapshot_type, protocol, version, encoding, compression, payload_b64, payload_sha256, payload_size_bytes, created_by, source_repo, source_ref, is_active
) VALUES (
  'mission_runs_v1',
  'UBIN',
  '1.0',
  'json',
  'gzip',
  '{{$json.payload_b64_sql}}',
  '{{$json.payload_sha256_sql}}',
  {{Math.trunc($json.payload_size_bytes)}},
  'snapshot-update',
  'platform',
  NULL,
  true
) RETURNING snapshot_id::text, payload_sha256, payload_size_bytes, snapshot_type;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'updated', run_id: ($node['Upsert Mission Run'].json.run_id || $node['Upsert Mission Run'].json[0]?.run_id || null), snapshot_type: ($json[0]?.snapshot_type || $json.snapshot_type || 'mission_runs_v1'), payload_sha256: ($json[0]?.payload_sha256 || $json.payload_sha256 || null), payload_size_bytes: Number($json[0]?.payload_size_bytes || $json.payload_size_bytes || 0), snapshot_id: ($json[0]?.snapshot_id || $json.snapshot_id || null) } }}
